title: Remove PR review screenshots committed under docs/ (docs/pr-1711, docs/reviews/1756, docs/review/1765)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:low
labels.description: Mechanical, one file, no new logic (issue-worker-low)

body:
What happens: three merged PRs committed their review screenshots into the product tree on `main`. They are review evidence, not documentation. They make the repository bigger and are not used by the site or the app.

Files on `main` (from `git ls-tree upstream/main`):
- `docs/pr-1711/README.md`
- `docs/pr-1711/after/hover.png`
- `docs/pr-1711/after/left.png`
- `docs/pr-1711/after/rest.png`
- `docs/pr-1711/before/hover.png`
- `docs/pr-1711/before/left.png`
- `docs/pr-1711/before/rest.png`
- `docs/pr-1771/after.png`
- `docs/pr-1771/before.png`
- `docs/review/1765/README.md`
- `docs/review/1765/passes-after.png`
- `docs/review/1765/passes-before.png`
- `docs/review/1765/validate.py`
- `docs/reviews/1756/README.md`
- `docs/reviews/1756/after.png`
- `docs/reviews/1756/before.png`

They came in with PR #1711 (`docs/pr-1711/`), PR #1756 (`docs/reviews/1756/`) and PR #1765 (`docs/review/1765/`).

Where PR screenshots belong: the PR body, with images on the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch of the author's fork (raw.githubusercontent URLs). Nothing under `docs/` or anywhere in the product tree.

Fix:
1. Remove the three folders in one `chore` PR. First check that no page or test refers to them (`git grep -n "pr-1711\|reviews/1756\|review/1765"`).
2. Prevention, on the agent side (done by mkinney, 2026-11-15): the Codex and agy briefs now say "never commit screenshots or review images to the PR branch". Optional: a reviewer check that refuses new PNG/JPG files under `docs/` unless the PR is a docs PR that uses them on the site.

Done means: the three folders are gone from `main`, nothing links to them, and `zola build` in `site/` still passes.
